notes.title: Patch v2.00
notes.content:
Suspicious Downpour Patch v2.00 - Localization and Quality of Life Improvements.

Due to popular demand we have now localized Suspicious Downpour into four more languages.
The language can be changed on first start up and can also be swapped at any time using the main menu settings. So if you want a challenge feel free to use one you don't understand :)

Some of you veteran campers will notice the improvements in the overall lighting and grass quality.
With this new grass you can experience the woods like never before. But don't worry you can still completely remove it all if you really want to.

Thanks again to everyone who has helped improve Suspicious Downpour with their feedback!
A Very positive (95%) review score from 146 reviews was a target we never expected to hit <3

=========================================

Patch v2.00 Notes:

Languages added:
 - German
 - Spanish
 - Russian
 - Japanese

Quality of life changes:
 - Drastically improved grass lighting when lit from flashlight.
 - Redesigned bushes.
 - Tweaked flashlight strength.

Updated:
- Options menu to allow the other languages to fit.
- Every menu to fix scaling issues.

notes.title: Patch v1.01
notes.content:
Suspicious Downpour Patch v1.01 - More Settings!

Due to some feedback we've received we decided to add three more settings in the settings menu! So even those of you who prefer inverted camera controls can play! :D And because the settings have a larger presence in the game we also added the ability to change them in the main menu. 

This is a very short game so we decided to add a disclaimer at the start so that everyone is informed about the experience they are about to witness.

We'd also like to thank everyone who has supported Suspicious Downpour! We have had an amazingly positive reception that frankly we did not expect so thank you so much! <3 Now for the actual patch notes!

=== WARNING! POTENTIAL SPOILERS AHEAD! ===

Patch v1.01 Notes:

Updated the settings menu, users can now:
        - Change their mouse sensitivity.
        - Invert their vertical camera controls.
        - Change their fullscreen mode.

Bugs we've squashed:
        - The text and menus in the game should now scale properly to each player's window size.
        - The player can no longer throw sandwiches when in a menu.

Other things we added:
       - The disclaimer menu at the very start of the game.
       - A version number in the main menu.
       - We extended the time it takes for the cinematic mode text to fade away.
